subject: BluePeak: request for VM evidence & SIG/SOC2 supplemental
messages:
From: Alex Chen <security@bluepeak.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.example>
Cc: Priya Shah <procurement@bluepeak.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T09:13:00Z
Subject: Request: VM evidence for SOC2 SIG supplemental (scan cadence + CVE closure)

Hi Logan,

Thanks again for the call this morning. BluePeak is wrapping up our SIG review and the SOC2 supplemental requests landed on my desk. Two specific asks we need evidence for before Friday:

1) Scan cadence documentation for internet-facing and internal assets (last 6 months).
2) CVE remediation evidence for critical/high CVEs tied to our integration (we flagged 7 CVEs during the questionnaire). We need: discovery timestamps, owner, remediation date, and verification scan results.

Can Redwood provide a single package that includes:
- a table of scan runs (dates, scope, tool, major version),
- per-CVE handoff/closure log (who owned it, PR/CH ticket id, patched image tag or mitigation),
- a short attestation statement signed by a security ops lead confirming the SLAs we commit to for CVE triage/remediation (critical = 7 days, high = 30 days) and current status for BluePeak-related CVEs.

If possible, include a timeline snapshot that maps detection->remediation->retest for the 7 CVEs. We can accept CSV and PDFs. I can route the package to our compliance team once we have it.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Chen
Security Analyst, BluePeak Capital
security@bluepeak.com

[Attachment: BluePeak_SIG_Supplemental_Request.pdf]

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.example>
To: Alex Chen <security@bluepeak.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example>, Priya Shah <procurement@bluepeak.com>
Date: 2026-11-23T11:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: VM evidence for SOC2 SIG supplemental (scan cadence + CVE closure)

Alex — thanks for the clear list. We can deliver a consolidated evidence bundle. Quick clarifying questions so we scope the package correctly:

1) For "internet-facing and internal assets" — do you want all assets in the BluePeak integration project (prod+staging) or only prod? If you need both, we'll include a column for environment.
2) For the 7 CVEs you mentioned, can you paste the CVE IDs in a reply (or confirm they're the ones from the SIG form)? I want to ensure we match entries to the same IDs.

Plan: I'll coordinate with Security Ops to pull the last six months of authenticated scans and the per-CVE closure evidence. Marissa, Ben — can you prepare the CSV index (scan dates, scope, scanner version), the CVE closure log, and a signed attestation text? Aim for an initial package tomorrow EOD; final PDF handback by Thursday EOD for BluePeak to review.

Alex — if that's acceptable, send the CVE list and I will track HS-4589 (internal ticket) for this request.

—Logan
Logan Wright
Customer Security Manager, Redwood Inference
log[email redacted]@redwood.example

> Thanks again for the call this morning. BluePeak is wrapping up our SIG review and the SOC2 supplemental requests landed on my desk....

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.example>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example>, Alex Chen <security@bluepeak.com>, Priya Shah <procurement@bluepeak.com>
Date: 2026-11-24T15:18:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: VM evidence for SOC2 SIG supplemental (scan cadence + CVE closure)

Logan / Alex — pulled together the artifacts for the BluePeak package. Summary below and attached index files.

What we are attaching (initial package):
- bp_scan_index_2026-10.csv (CSV): authenticated and unauthenticated scan runs from 2026-06-01 through 2026-11-01. Columns: date, environment (prod/staging), scope (public/private), scanner (Trivy v0.46.0, Nessus 10.8), scan_owner.
- bp_cve_closure_log_2026-11.pdf (PDF): per-CVE timeline for the 7 CVEs you flagged. Each entry includes discovery timestamp, assigned owner, mitigation (patch image tag / config change), remediation date, verification scan id.
- redwood_vm_sla_statement.txt (TXT): signed SLA wording for triage/remediation (critical = 7 calendar days, high = 30 days, medium = 90 days) plus escalation path.
- screenshot-deployment-config.png (PNG): small screenshot of the deployment image tagging policy we referenced on the call.

Notes / caveats:
- For two CVEs one of the mitigations was a compensating control (WAF rule + backport patch) while the full upstream patch was applied to the next scheduled node image. Both are documented in the closure log with PR ids and verification scan ids.
- Our verification scans are run 48–72 hours after remediation by default; verification_scan_id is included in the PDF.
- Evidence package intentionally omits internal IPs in the public CSV; we list asset keys and environment so you can map them in your inventory. If you require raw IPs, we'll need a signed NDA addendum for export.

Alex — confirm receipt and whether BluePeak needs a single signed PDF or individual files; we can produce both. Logan — Ben, can you add a one-paragraph attestation from security ops confirming the timelines and that the listed CVEs are closed for BluePeak scope? We should sign that and attach to the PDF bundle.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Security Operations Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.example

Attachments:
- bp_scan_index_2026-10.csv
- bp_cve_closure_log_2026-11.pdf
- redwood_vm_sla_statement.txt
- screenshot-deployment-config.png

Alex / Priya — attaching the signed attestation and a short closure note for BluePeak.

Attestation (excerpt):
Redwood Inference attests that, for assets in scope for the BluePeak integration as listed in bp_scan_index_2026-10.csv, vulnerability discovery and remediation follows the documented VM process. For critical CVEs we commit to a remediation or compensating-control implementation within 7 calendar days of triage; for high severity within 30 calendar days. The seven CVEs submitted by BluePeak (see bp_cve_closure_log_2026-11.pdf) have been remediated and verified; verification scan ids are included in the PDF.

Signed: Ben Carter
Senior Security Operations Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.example

Best,
Ben
